entities.name: Czech National Revival
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Scholars like Josef Dobrovský and Josef Jungmann revived the Czech language from near-extinction. František Palacký's 'History of the Czech Nation' provided a national narrative, and the National Museum (1818) became a symbol of cultural identity.
